scope: Production v1 with a cancellable private mission for a single light detour and up to 3 mining ticks before banking near the end. Use 4 previously exposed development terrains from source families disjoint from prior endgame study, and another preregistered 4 source terrains for evaluation. No reserved 90 percent maps or native opponent runs.
window: 8 launch decisions per source game: H=12..5 inclusive. Look at all 16 games and both physical seats; each full branch starts only at the first actual public candidate action that differs from v1, never choose by result. Keep null in the analysis.
interface: Public seat observation, public history at or before current tick, own simultaneously proposed v1 orders, public rules, retained prior mission only. Hidden terrain or seed excluded. No later source enemy action except actual simultaneous root replay on scoring side.
alg: Consider collectors with cargo>0 whose v1 root command moves nearer to an owned bank. Test current public carbon cell or an adjacent currently visible (or recently observed <=2 turns) carbon patch and up to three mine ticks. Need a complete timed route to one of both owned banks with >=1 spare turn on admission. Reject own conflicts (shared bank only at last turn), enemy bases, unsafely contestable immediate cell, near enemy forecast, visible wasting treasury and failure to cover route to bank. Discount old cell carbon, count harvest depletion, projecting known tree tax along full path, and risk to held principal. Compare proposed terminal margin proxy to a shortest safe direct bank baseline, charging time and detour. Start only if net estimated extra>=12; choose highest score then deterministically tie-break. Once underway replan every tick under fresh observed risks; cancel and fall back where safe route/affordable wait disappears; any pending harvest can instead convert to early return. One mission per branch; other workers and recruiters follow v1.
rule_scope: Target visible cell only; credits from mining must be separately carried and delivered, no credit from merely holding cargo. No grant/deployment based on geometric scores. Report source gaps/real losses and missed opportunities; late outcome 3 proxy future policies does not identify true Master response; do not compare them as 3 independent games.
eval: At all 8 launch times compute changes, true and negative opportunity headroom and costs, including source identity, map, seat, exposure. Earliest issued root per game is the only branch. Evaluate v1 all remaining moves, one open-loop intervention then v1, and cancellable commitment + v1, under finitely three public branch-reactive opponent policies after both take recorded simultaneous opponent root. Preserve all lookahead paths, no new true examiner invocation. Require eligibility to request subsequent separate native intervention: >=2 of 4 heldout terrains with an actual edit; median across scenarios of full-cohort mean margin > 0; no controlled branch loses more than 100 relative margin; report wins separately. No positive finding is a 90% claim.
